pages.title: About Us
intro: At JD Hardware, we believe finding the right products for your home, garden, workspace and everyday needs should be straightforward, convenient and reliable.

Operated by JD Hardware Co., JD Hardware is a UK-based online retail store offering a diverse selection of products across home improvement, outdoor living, power equipment, heating, wellness, electronics and gaming.
Through our website, https://jdhardware.shop, we aim to bring together products from different categories in one convenient shopping destination.

Whether you are improving your garden, upgrading your computer equipment, maintaining your property or exploring new home technology, our goal is to help you shop with clear information and confidence.

pages.title: Frequently Asked Questions
pages.tagline: Welcome to the JD Hardware Help Centre.
intro: Welcome to the JD Hardware Help Centre.
Find answers to common questions about products, orders, shipping, returns, refunds and customer support.
pages.description: Find answers to common questions about products, orders, shipping, returns, refunds and customer support.

blocks.text: Welcome to the JD Hardware Help Centre.
Find answers to common questions about products, orders, shipping, returns, refunds and customer support.

blocks.question: What is JD Hardware?
blocks.answer: JD Hardware is a UK online retail store operated by JD Hardware Co., offering products across home improvement, outdoor living, power equipment, heating, electronics and gaming.

blocks.question: Where is JD Hardware located?
blocks.answer: Our business address is 280A Norwood Road, Norwood, London SE27 9AJ, United Kingdom.

blocks.question: What products do you sell?
blocks.answer: Our categories include lawn and garden products, outdoor power equipment, fireplaces, wood stoves, saunas, computer equipment, gaming consoles and home improvement products.

blocks.question: How can I contact JD Hardware?
blocks.answer: Email info@jdhardware.shop or telephone 020 7606 3333.

blocks.question: Is live chat available?
blocks.answer: Yes. Our live chat is available 24/7.

blocks.question: How do I place an order?
blocks.answer: Select your products, add them to your basket and follow the checkout instructions.

blocks.question: What currency do you use?
blocks.answer: Our store uses pounds sterling (GBP).

blocks.question: What payment methods do you accept?
blocks.answer: The payment methods currently available are displayed during checkout.

blocks.question: Can I cancel an order?
blocks.answer: Contact us as soon as possible if you wish to cancel. Your statutory cancellation rights may apply even after an order has entered fulfilment.

blocks.question: Can I change my delivery address?
blocks.answer: Contact support immediately. Address changes may not be possible after dispatch.

blocks.question: Where do you deliver?
blocks.answer: We currently deliver within the United Kingdom only.

blocks.question: Do you offer international delivery?
blocks.answer: No. International shipping is not currently available.

blocks.question: How much does shipping cost?
blocks.answer: Standard shipping is free throughout the United Kingdom.

blocks.question: What is your order cut-off time?
blocks.answer: 5:00 PM UK local time.

blocks.question: How long does order processing take?
blocks.answer: Typically 1–2 business days.

blocks.question: How long does delivery take after dispatch?
blocks.answer: Estimated transit time is 3–5 business days.

blocks.question: What is the total estimated delivery time?
blocks.answer: Approximately 4–7 business days.

blocks.question: What are your business days?
blocks.answer: Monday through Friday, excluding applicable UK bank holidays.

blocks.question: Will I receive tracking information?
blocks.answer: Where tracking is available, it may be provided after dispatch.

blocks.question: What if my order is delayed?
blocks.answer: Contact customer support with your order number and delivery information.

blocks.question: What if my parcel arrives damaged?
blocks.answer: Contact us promptly with photographs and your order information where possible.

blocks.question: What is your return window?
blocks.answer: 28 days for eligible returns under our standard store policy.

blocks.question: Can I return a product if I change my mind?
blocks.answer: Yes, eligible non-defective products can be returned under the applicable conditions.

blocks.question: Do you accept defective returns?
blocks.answer: Yes. Statutory rights relating to faulty goods also apply.

blocks.question: Are returns free?
blocks.answer: Yes. We provide return labels for approved returns at no additional charge.

blocks.question: Do you charge restocking fees?
blocks.answer: No. Our restocking fee is £0.00.

blocks.question: Do you offer exchanges?
blocks.answer: No. Direct exchanges are not currently available.

blocks.question: How do I request a return?
blocks.answer: Contact info@jdhardware.shop with your order number and reason for return.

blocks.question: How long do refunds take?
blocks.answer: We aim to process eligible refunds within 10 days after the returned product is received and approved, subject to statutory requirements.

blocks.question: How will I receive my refund?
blocks.answer: Approved refunds are normally issued to the original payment method.

blocks.question: Does your return policy affect my statutory rights?
blocks.answer: No. Applicable UK consumer rights remain unaffected.

blocks.question: Do products come with a warranty?
blocks.answer: Warranty coverage depends on the product and any applicable manufacturer warranty.

blocks.question: Do you provide installation?
blocks.answer: Installation is not included unless specifically stated in the product listing.

blocks.question: Can I ask about product compatibility?
blocks.answer: Yes. Contact us with the product details before purchasing.
